snippet.title: Darn Guy Adventures - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Darn Guy Adventures (AKA DGA) is a free ~4 hour RPG adventure based around attempting to find news about a certain videogame.
GAME PAGE: https://definitelytinta.itch.io/darn-guy-adventures

The full OST by @Kisher02 is available here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdBjKMJpr2L4tl9WtTmjLwT8GKHGPqE9Q&si=8-GpQbFYzgAz0DU-
